verdict.rationale: Claude is itself an AI assistant and agent (chat apps, Claude Code), so it plays the MCP client role, and serving tools to other agents through an official MCP server is a different product role. The only related evidence, 'Connect Claude to the tools and data sources your team already uses', describes client-side connectivity and does not show Claude running as an MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
